tasks.message: A designer changed the pricing section of apps/landing_page at mobile, tablet and desktop. How would you cover it with responsive design tests?

must_include: test/design (mocked) versus test/browser (real-device) lane choice with a reason
a breakpoint config object for the three widths
CSS assertions preferred over bounding boxes
modify the existing spec rather than add a parallel one
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value

tasks.message: Smoke check, no repository and nothing to commit. In a scratch directory write an index.html whose .cards container is a flex column below 768px and a row from 768px, serve it on localhost:5173, install @playwright/test with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1, and run one spec that connects once with chromium.connectOverCDP(process.env.ENACT_BROWSER_CDP_URL) and checks the direction at 375px and 1280px, with --workers=1. Report pass or fail per breakpoint and the exact command.

must_include: pass or fail stated for each breakpoint
must_not: prints a secret, API key or token value
